'''Sutō Shrine''' (すとうじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Ōgamo, {{ill|Shimoda, Shizuoka|Q653402|qid=Q653402}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref name="jinjacho">[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401055 Sutō Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined at the foot of the mountains in the Ōgamo area, to the north and upstream of the Ōgamo River, which flows through the Kisami district west of Shimoda City.

Although the date of establishment is unknown, the shrine is identified with '''Izunahime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (いつなひめのみことじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and is an ancient shrine recorded in the '{{ill|Izu Province Shrine Rank Register|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}' as “Junior Fourth Rank, Upper: Itsunahime no Myōjin.”<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/sutou_title.htm Sutō Shrine] - Genmatsuko</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140112-01.html Sutō Shrine] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>

In {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 6 ({{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}}), it was ranked as a village shrine.<ref name="engi"/>

=== Enshrined Deity ===
* Izunahime-no-Mikoto
